coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Pier 70 Parcel B
record.summary: Large commercial-office parcel on 20th Street at the waterfront, next to the ship-repair yard; 90 ft / six stories under the D4D. It is an option parcel of a later phase (Phase 3B in the Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan) and no design, appraisal or construction record for it was found (see open questions).

notes.accuracy_caveat: The outline is the union of Assessor lots 4052008 and 4052012, so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a trace. That this is the lot of Parcel B is Pier & Point's own inference from location, shape and size (our earlier trace of the D4D figure measured 6,199 m2 against the lot's 8,742 m2; 100% of the trace lies inside the lot and the trace covers 71% of it). No Port document read ties the lot number to it. A building may sit back from the lot lines. No vertical construction is reported on this block (Port Item 11A, Aug 7, 2026, says construction of Phase 1 vertical projects and parks has not moved forward; it places this block in Phase 3B of its proposed phasing plan, outside Phase 1, and does not mention construction on it).
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 4052008 and 4052012 (recorded 2019-02-07; mapped 2019-03-14; active), joined into one outline; cross-checked against Pier 70 Design for Development Figure 6.4.2 - Building Height Maximum (p.155).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: No single Assessor lot is documented as Parcel B. Lots 4052008 and 4052012 (active) match its location, shape and size, so its outline is the union of Assessor lots 4052008 and 4052012; the identification is Pier & Point's inference, as the accuracy note says.
notes.regulatory_context: Office (Commercial-Office in all three D4D land-use scenarios, Figures 1.5.5-1.5.7; not residential/mixed-use), 90 ft max per Figure 6.4.2 (6-story cap for commercial buildings per D4D Section 6.4.2, not the sometimes-cited '6-8 stories'). Phase 3B in the Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan (Port Item 11A, Exhibit A; the pump station site is shown as included in the earlier of 3A or 3B). No square footage for this parcel is stated in the D4D or Port Items 9B and 11A; a ~500,000 RSF figure previously recorded here came from an uncited leasing brochure and has been dropped. No construction-start source found.

changes.text: The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2042 date comes from the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance. That was wrong. The Port's 2017 staff report (Item 9B, p.7) puts the Schedule of Performance in the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA) between the Port and the developer, which is a different agreement from the Development Agreement between the City and the developer. The report says the developer must complete phase 3 within approximately 25 years of project approval, but it never states the year 2042; 2042 is Pier & Point's own arithmetic (2017 plus 25 years). It stays labelled a legal outside date, not an expected completion.

That left out what Bisnow reports: its October 20, 2022 article says 'progress stalled in April', after 'a work stoppage earlier this year', so the halt is dated April 2022 (the year follows from 'earlier this year' in an October 2022 article). open_questions: No construction start, building permit or vertical DDA for this parcel was found in any Port Commission document through the Port's Item 11A staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026, for the Aug 11, 2026 meeting), which says the developer 'has not exercised an option of any Phase 1 option parcels'.

Per-parcel gross square footage and unit counts are not published in the D4D (which sets height, stories and land-use scenarios, not parcel programs); the SUD's per-parcel programs would be in the SUD ordinance (Planning Code Sec. 249.79) or the Phase Submittal, neither of which was retrieved.

Brookfield's leasing brochure reportedly lists Parcel B at about 500,000 RSF (dropped from this parcel's map notes as uncited); the brochure could not be checked (pier70sf.com/leasing shows only project-wide totals of 1.82M RSF new office and 250,000 RSF historic rehab), so no square footage is stated here.
The 2017 DDA terms tie the Arts Building start to completion of 'the office building on Parcel B-2'; whether 'B-2' is a sub-parcel of B is not explained in the retrieved text.
No design submittal or appraisal for Parcel B was found in the Port Commission documents cited on this page.
